title: dactylorhiza × nummiana
intro: Dactylorhiza × nummiana, commonly known as the Island Spotted Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza maculata and Coeloglossum viride. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use in reducing inflammation and pain. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × nummiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents, particularly the flavonoids, are believed to contribute to the plant's therapeutic actions, providing relief from respiratory issues and promoting overall well-being.
